artBrief: **French romantic fantasy.** A miniature illuminated palace surrounded by roses, with a book-shaped gate and a moonlit garden. The central facade must survive thumbnail reduction.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. French romantic fantasy. A miniature illuminated palace surrounded by roses, with a book-shaped gate and a moonlit garden. The central facade must survive thumbnail reduction. Use a single central luminous symmetrical palace facade with an obvious open-book gateway. Large dark rose silhouettes frame the lower corners; lavender moonlight and warm windows.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
